metadata.datasource: Measured off Kodak F-4017 (2021), KODAK PROFESSIONAL TRI-X 400 Film / 400TX, 35 mm, D-76 developer, large tank, 10.75 min at 20 C, Kodak's time for EI 1600 (2-stop push), interpolated between the published 10 and 12 minute curves along exposure at each density; diffuse visual density. Characteristic curve laid on agx's axis with mid-grey where a meter set to EI 1600 puts it on the sheet's absolute axis (log H -2.294); the curve's own ISO speed point is ISO 501; base + fog 0.321. Continued at its final gradient for 0.8 decades past the last plotted exposure. Spectral sensitivity: as Tri-X 400, the D = 1.0 over gross fog curve. One silver layer, carried as three identical channels.
